sampleRows.Standard Pricing:
Pricing Tiers
eSIM Go offers multiple tiers of pricing - Standard, Silver and Gold.  If you have any questions, requirements or would like to discuss moving pricing tier please contact your Account Manager.
The current pricing tier assigned to your account can be viewed in the eSIM Go Management Portal. 

Minimum monthly spend requirements are:
 - Standard - $0 per month
 - Silver - $25,000 per month
 - Gold - $100,000 per month
Monthly spend is calculated over an average spend per quarter.  Pricing tiers are reviewed quarterly and are implemented at the sole discretion of eSIM Go

Technical Service Agreement and Acceptable Use Policy
All connections are subject to our Technical Service Agreement and Acceptable Use Policy, both of which can be found here:
https://esimgo.com/technical-service-agreement
https://esimgo.com/acceptable-use-policy

Data Charging Increments
All bundles are deducted in 1 kb increments.  1GB = 1,000 MB = 1,000,000,000 bytes.

Regional Bundle Network Coverage
Regional bundle coverage may vary from that of single country-bundles. Please ensure that you are checking the coverage for the correct Profile of you bundle.

Data Throttling
All standard fixed-quantity bundles are unthrottled, which means your users will always get the very best experience and quality of data available based on available network coverage. 

 - Unlimited Lite - These bundles provide 1GB of data at unthrottled 5G (where available) speeds per 24 hours and thereafter unlimited data at 512kbs.  The 24h period is calculated from the point the bundle is first used.  The unthrottled data allowance will reset every 24 hours for the validity of the bundle.
 - Unlimited Essential - These bundles provide 1GB of data at unthrottled 5G (where available) speeds per 24 hours and thereafter unlimited data at 1.25mbs.  The 24h period is calculated from the point the bundle is first used.  The unthrottled data allowance will reset every 24 hours for the validity of the bundle.
 - Unlimited Plus - These bundles provide 2GB of data at unthrottled 5G (where available) speeds per 24 hours and thereafter unlimited data at 2mbs.  The 24h period is calculated from the point the bundle is first used.  The unthrottled data allowance will reset every 24 hours for the validity of the bundle.
 - Long Duration bundles throttle streaming services to 2mbps. All other data usage will remain unthrottled.

Regulatory
To comply with local telecoms regulations and the terms of our agreement with du, no eSIM, for any country or region, should be sold within the geographical boundary of the UAE without a license. If sales are identified as taking place within the UAE your eSIM Go account may be suspended.

Permanent Roaming
The bundles found in this sheet are intended for travel purposes only. Permanent Roaming (usage for 60 or more consecutive days in a single country) is not permitted with these bundles.

Data Breakout
This is dependant on the Profile in use. Profile 1 offers breakout in Europe. Profiles 2 and 3 offer breakout in Europe, Singapore and North America. Profile 4 offers breakout in Europe.  

Bundle/eSIM Validity Period & Top-Ups - Effective 1st June 2025
Once purchased, a data bundle remains available to use as a top-up or on a new eSIM for 6 months.  The data bundle validity period (7 to 30 days) starts once the first 1 kb of data is used.  
An eSIM is valid for 6 months from assignment, last top-up or last usage, whichever is later.  After that date the eSIM will expire and the end-user will require a new one.

Confidentiality
This price list is confidential and its sharing is strictly forbidden

Bundle Refunding
Bundles that have not been started can be refunded to balance within 60 days of the bundles purchase.

Coverage
Profile IDs match to ICCID prefixes in the following way:
ICCID prefix 89444 = Profile ID 1
ICCID prefix 89320 = Profile IDs 2 and 3
ICCID prefix 89431 = Profile ID 4
ICCID prefix 89353 = Profile ID 5
